title: Emit
say: Six sources each log in their own shape. None of them knows about the others.

title: Normalize
say: One envelope, with the W3C trace id parsed strictly. A bad traceparent is flagged, never trusted.

title: Store
say: Appended to a hash chain. Edit, delete, insert or reorder and verify fails.

title: Query
say: Three read-only tools. A window past retention is clamped and said so, never silently emptied.

title: Join
say: Correlation ids stitch the timeline. Orphans and gaps are shown, not guessed.
